snippet.title: Project Saphi - Public Beta Trailer
snippet.description:
The Saphi team is pleased to announce that the Saphi mod to play Crash Team Racing custom track time trials is ready for open beta!

* How to play?
To get started, please make an account at: https://5ever.crashteamranking.com/signup.php
Download the latest client at: https://github.com/Project-Saphi/Saphi/releases/latest
If you plan to play on Steam deck, make sure to download the Linux static build.

* Join the Discord Community: https://discord.gg/6mxqGJmkKJ

Credits:
* Developers: @TheRedhotbr , @theubmunster9446 , @Jasu14 , @Garma1337 , @niikctr 
* Artists: @NyXx_CTR , @victorards , @BoxicFunk 
* Trailer: @Looper231Xd
